summary.result: The result indicated that both SWAT model and Tank model simulated runoff reasonably during calibration and validation period.
summary.background: The objective of this study was to evaluate of the Tank model in simulating runoff discharge from rural watershed in comparison to the SWAT (Soil and Water Assessment Tool) model.
summary.method: The model parameters of SWAT was calibrated by the shuffled complex evolution-university Arizona (SCE-UA) method while Tank model was calibrated by genetic algorithm (GA) and validated.
